newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malaysian premier pays state visit to Malawi.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian premier pays state visit to Malawi.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad arrived in Blantyre, Malawi's main commercial city, on Thursday for a three-day state visit.
He was welcomed at Blantyre's Chileka Airport by Malawian President Bakili Muluzi.

This is the first time that a Malaysian leader has visited Malawi since 1994, when the southern African country became a multiparty state after 30 years of one party rule under former "life president" Kamuzu Banda.
